_comment_webauthn: RelyingPartyId is the parent domain so a passkey works on every subdomain (like the SSO cookie). Origins is the exact allowlist of browser origins that run the passkey ceremonies (the login/security pages) — never a wildcard. Dev values are in appsettings.Development.json.
_comment: Jwt:SigningKey, Encryption:DataKey and Seed:AdminPassword are secrets. Provide them via user-secrets or environment variables (Jwt__SigningKey, Encryption__DataKey, Seed__AdminPassword) — never commit them.
_comment_config_source: The NON-SECRET Jwt/Sso/WebAuthn/Seed values below are seed defaults + fallback only. At runtime they are sourced from the Mongo 'config' doc (_id app-config), loaded at startup by AppConfigLoader — edit them there, not in env. Secrets above always come from env.
_comment_publicconfig: Non-secret, shareable app config served at GET /api/config so sibling apps don't duplicate it. Seeds the DB on first run only; edit thereafter on the admin Settings screen.
